name: Kingdom of Bora Bora (until 1888)
description: Five horizontal stripes alternating red and white, red at the top and bottom.
history: Submitted by the chiefs of Bora Bora in 1847, when the Leeward Islands were guaranteed independence by the Jarnac Convention, and confirmed by Rear-Admiral Stirling in 1880. France annexed the kingdom in 1888, though the last queen, Teriimaevarua III, was not deposed until 1895.
